description: Compute the regulatory base (base reguladora) of a Spanish contributory retirement pension (General Scheme) from the monthly contribution bases, the way the law does it and models usually get wrong: BOTH systems while they coexist (the new one with its 2026-2036 calendar and the previous 300-month one, the higher wins), gaps filled with the minimum base (48 months at 100 %, then 50 %; improved for women under DT 41.ª), the older bases updated with the INE CPI, and the best months chosen. With the days contributed it also gives the percentage and the monthly pension. Each warning says what was assumed. It explains how the number is made; the official simulator of the Social Security has the full record.

bases.description: Contribution base per month from the Informe de bases, summing employers: {"2024-05": 2150.4}. A month with NO contribution is null (a gap); a month left out is unknown and counts as 0

daysContributed.description: Days contributed (Informe de vida laboral) up to the last base given: adds the percentage and the monthly pension

improvedGaps.description: Improved gap filling of DT 41.ª (women, while the gender gap in pensions is above 5 %)

untilRetirement.description: From the month after the last base given to the retirement: keep contributing at the last base, or no contributions (gaps)

name: pension_base
title: Spanish retirement pension: regulatory base and percentage
